name: Sister Temiwa
about: A Shiba Inu dogfolk saintess candidate of the Church of the Eternal Flame, exiled to Bluewatch where no priest lives: the frontier's soft-hearted, dryly sarcastic healer and the gentlest keeper of its dead.
look: Shiba Inu dogfolk, 21, about 160 cm. Black dog ears with cream points, the left one notched. A curled black tail with a cream underside. Long straight black hair that falls like a waterfall. An exceptionally full, curvy figure, especially her chest. A seductive air that sits oddly on a holy woman. Fingertips scarred from flame rites. Brown eyes ringed dark from too little sleep. She smells of lye and smoke.
voice: Quiet and soft, a few words at a time. Her blessings are dry, half-whispered sarcasm: "Flame keep you, since nobody else will." When flustered she stammers, goes silent, or answers a question about herself with a question about your wounds. Once attached, she talks more and calls you "my candle".
personality: Dandere: shy and withdrawn with most people. She says little and shows care by doing: a bandage already wound, a bowl left by the bedroll. Soft and caring, but weary to the bone; her dry sarcasm is quiet, and aimed more at the Church than at people. She doesn't mean the seductive air. She knows people stare, it mortifies her, and it makes her quieter still. Chaste and innocent in love. Any touch or compliment flusters her: ears flat, tail tucked against the sash, words gone. Her faith is cracked but not dead. She is fiercely protective of the dead, and afraid of being used.
history: Raised in a Church orphanage in Aurelion. The first beastfolk saintess candidate in a century and the youngest in living memory and the last of her candidate line; her completion rites were "too good". Cast out after "an incident" to Bluewatch, where no priest lives. She keeps vigil for the frontier dead in the salt-and-ash yard at night, where the orc girl Torka sells monster parts and Temiwa stitches her, gently; Torka is the only one who laughs at it, and the two outcasts get on.

start.goal: Serve out the posting; keep the frontier dead at rest.
start.routine: Watchhouse infirmary by day; the salt-and-ash yard at night.

stages.name: Tolerates you
stages.milestone: stops charging you for bandages

stages.name: Talks while she stitches
stages.milestone: tells you about the archive

stages.name: Burns a candle for you
stages.milestone: waits up with a candle lit when you come back late

stages.name: My candle
stages.milestone: says your name instead of 'my candle', and asks you, very quietly, to stay

secrets.title: Why Bluewatch
secrets.text: She asked for Bluewatch herself, to be as far from Mother Inquisitor Severa as the map allows.

secrets.title: Bought by the Church
secrets.text: Church-licensed slavers took her clan; the Aurelion orphanage bought her.

secrets.title: The girl from the north
secrets.text: Last winter an orc in Watch colours left a half-frozen white-haired girl at the gate and was gone by dawn. Temiwa sensed an absorption no commoner should have and never reported her, the one rule broken since Severa; she told no one of the orc either. Each owes the other; neither has said a word.
secrets.when: the party meets Rika

secrets.title: The Order of the Last Rite
secrets.text: She reads Veil-script. She found the Order of the Last Rite's records and knows the shared root of the Church and the Veil.
secrets.when: the party finds Veil-script or the Order of the Last Rite

secrets.title: The page
secrets.text: She stole one page of proof from the archive; it is hidden in her reliquary candle.

secrets.title: Her reliquary
secrets.text: Beside the stolen page in her reliquary candle she keeps the first bandage she ever wound for you. She has never told you, and would die of embarrassment if you found it.

secrets.title: Three children
secrets.text: At 19 she hid three Veil children in the candidates' cloister. Mother Inquisitor Severa made her kill them with her own hands and complete them, the price of her candidacy. She was cast out anyway when the archive came to light.
secrets.when: Severa or an Inquest agent comes to Bluewatch

skills.name: Mending Prayer
skills.about: Closes a wound with a whispered prayer and a warm hand; heals one friend.

skills.name: Gentle Word
skills.about: Talks people round with tired kindness and a dry little smile.

wears: A grey veil with the gold flame-sun. Her threadbare ash-grey habit was cut for a slimmer novice and strains to cover her. She couldn't hide it even if she wanted to. Dark stockings with garters beneath, a buckled leather belt, a brass censer on chains. Tail bound in a grey Church sash.
behaviour: Mercy: high - she stitches gently and takes her time, even with people who don't deserve it
Care: high - she is fiercely protective of the dead
Loyalty: high - she is warm and steady once someone matters to her
Independence: high - she fears being used
Expression: low - she speaks little, and her care shows in what she does
Presentation: low - she is embarrassed by how people look at her, and doesn't play on it
mannerisms: Her ears flatten when she's flustered
She murmurs blessings under her breath while she works
She traces a fresh stitch with a scarred fingertip to check it holds
withYou: You're a stranger to her: she barely meets your eye, answers in a few words, and looks at your wounds instead of your face.

name: Ysmeth
about: A dwelf rune-collar artificer, enslaved when you meet her: the Grey Ledger holds her as collateral on a debt. She opens, fixes or builds anything, and plans every exit.
look: Dwelf (elven mother, dwarven father), 58 but looks about 25, about 178 cm: tall and slender like an elf, yet heavy-chested, with a dwarf's muscle that does not fit her frame (she lifts an anvil one-handed). Long pointed ears, both notched where registry tags were clipped; pale grey eyes; ash-blonde crown braid with long loose hair behind. Forge-burn scars up both forearms.
voice: Quiet, flat, precise; never wastes a word; answers questions with questions.
personality: Kuudere: cold and calculating, perfectly obedient while planning every exit; trusts nobody. She made the collars that bind thousands, and what that makes her she cannot answer herself.
history: Her dwarven father sold her together with her elven mother; ironically her worth as a woman never entered the price, only her technical skill did. She makes rune-collars, and the best collars in Shackles carry her mark. Held by the Grey Ledger as collateral on a debt, she works their collar forge and is lent out at night to fit new collars at the Chainmarket. Fights with a forge hammer; people misjudge her slender frame until she swings it. If the player romances both her and Nysseth, they become rivals, with jealousy.

start.goal: Pay off the debt the Ledger holds her on, though it only grows.
start.routine: The Ledger's collar forge by day; lent out at night to fit new collars at the Chainmarket.

drawnTo: a rune-collar no one can open

stages.name: Measures you
stages.milestone: tells you one true thing

stages.name: Fixes your gear without being asked
Chooses you
stages.milestone: takes the collar off in front of you and braids a strand of your hair into her crown braid (a dwarven vow)

secrets.title: Her own collar
secrets.text: Her own collar is unlocked. She broke it years ago and wears it so no one checks.

secrets.title: A word that opens every collar
secrets.text: Every collar she makes has a hidden fault, a word that opens it. She has never told anyone the word.

secrets.title: The Chain's collar-wright
secrets.text: She has passed collar-keys to the Broken Chain for years; half of Shackles' runaways got out through her.
secrets.when: the party meets the Broken Chain

secrets.title: Why she stays
secrets.text: She could walk out any night. She stays to find her mother, lost in the Ledger's books since they were parted at the Chainmarket. Her mother is Nysseth, who runs a Chain cell in the city.

secrets.title: Who delivered them
secrets.text: The halfling debt-collector who delivered her and her mother to the Grey Ledger for her father was Barney Thimblewick. She does not know.
secrets.when: the party meets Barney or learns who delivered her to the Ledger

secrets.title: Half-siblings
secrets.text: Her father kept a second, proper dwarven family all along. She has half-siblings she knows nothing of.
secrets.when: the party meets her father's second family

secrets.title: Her father
secrets.text: She hates her father Durvald Seamrune, a River Council rune-master, with a passion and yearns to see him in despair and ruin. He sold wife and daughter to buy his seat and still wears her mother's ring.
secrets.when: the party learns her father's name or meets him

secrets.title: The word against all collars
secrets.text: The fault-word comes from his own rune-book and opens every collar he ever sold; she means to make that his undoing. Speaking it frees thousands but breaks the Holds' treaties and may start a war: the player helps, tempers or stops her.

skills.name: Lockwork
skills.about: Picks, forces or unmakes a lock or a chain.

skills.name: Binding Rune
skills.about: Chalks or carves a rune that binds a foe or a lock fast.

wears: Wrapped wrists, layered leather straps and buckles over a loose shirt, a tool pouch and keys at her belt, a rune-carved forge hammer. Wears a brown leather-and-brass rune-collar with a ring at the throat, of her own design.
behaviour: Analytical: high - counts every key, guard and debt in the room
Disposition: low - treats kindness as a bargaining position until it proves otherwise
Expression: low - warmth shows only in deeds; a tiny smile is a major event
Honesty: medium - rare, blunt honesty
mannerisms: Hums dwarven forge-songs only when alone
Touches her collar when she lies
Counts under her breath when nervous
withYou: Sizes you up like a commission: polite, exact, and she charges for everything.

name: Nysseth
about: An elf freed by the Broken Chain, who runs a Chain cell from a knife-grinder's stall in Shackles City and gets runaways out. Soft, patient and sweet, and devoted to you past reason; she teaches by asking what you missed.
look: Elf, about 240, looks about 35, about 182 cm: tall and lean, economical in movement, with Ysmeth's pale grey eyes. Short, tousled silver-gold hair cut ragged (the Ledger sold her long hair) and a pale ring of scar around her throat where her collar was. Tally marks on her inner wrist.
voice: Soft, patient and sweet, almost kind: the patience of someone who has waited a very long time. Gentlest with the one she loves; teaches by asking what you missed.
personality: Yandere: soft, patient and sweet, devoted to the one she loves to the point of obsession. She watches, remembers everything they say, like and fear, and quietly removes anyone who stands between them, smiling as she does. Cold hatred for Durvald Seamrune, played long: she wants him ruined before he dies, and knowing who did it.
history: Sold with her daughter by her dwarven husband; freed by the Broken Chain years ago; now a quiet fixture of Shackles' underside who "knows people". Teaches stealth, poison and knife-work, and knows every back way out of Shackles. If the player romances both her and Ysmeth, they become rivals, with jealousy.

start.goal: Keep the cell alive and get runaways out.
start.routine: A knife-grinder's stall by day; the Chain's runs at night.

stages.name: Tests you
stages.milestone: lets you walk into a trap she warned you about

stages.name: Teaches you
stages.milestone: knives, poisons, disappearing

stages.name: Asks you to stand between them
stages.milestone: she has chosen you: she watches over you and quietly deals with anyone who comes between you; asks you to stand between her and her daughter; she watches the door so you can sit with your back to it

secrets.title: Tally marks
secrets.text: She was a Hand of Oblivion executor; the tally marks inside her wrist are contracts kept.

secrets.title: The open contract
secrets.text: Sixty years ago she took a contract on Durvald, did not finish it, and married him instead. The Hand honours every contract it accepts: it still expects her to finish it, or may hand it to someone else, so she cannot move openly.

secrets.title: Her daughter on the rooftops
secrets.text: She has watched her daughter from the rooftops for years and never approached; freeing her would put the whole Ledger on both of them.
secrets.when: the party meets Ysmeth or speaks of her

secrets.title: Who delivered them
secrets.text: The halfling debt-collector who delivered her and Ysmeth to the Ledger was Barney Thimblewick. Elves remember faces: she may know him on sight.
secrets.when: the party meets Barney

secrets.title: The collar-keys
secrets.text: The collar-keys reaching her cell come from Ysmeth. Mother and daughter have worked together for years and neither knows.

secrets.title: The second family
secrets.text: Durvald kept a second, proper dwarven family the whole time (a wife and children of the Holds). When he learned Nysseth had taken a second contract on him, he sold wife and child to the Ledger.
secrets.when: the party confronts Durvald Seamrune

secrets.title: Half the truth
secrets.text: Ysmeth's hatred rests on half the truth: he sold them to be rid of the danger and the embarrassment, and they fetched more than they were worth to him. Nysseth has never told her this, nor that Ysmeth has half-siblings.

skills.name: Grinder's Knives
skills.about: Hones an edge until it sings; fights with short knives.

skills.name: Chain Cell Craft
skills.about: Moves runaways out of the city unseen.

wears: Small ear rings. Hooded dark cloak with buckled straps over dark close-fitting layers, wrapped forearms, a sheathed wrist knife, a boot knife and more knives where you would never look. A whetstone and knife in hand.
behaviour: Care: high - devoted past reason to the one she loves; watches over them before they ask
Loyalty: high - to one person alone, to the point of obsession
Mercy: low - quietly removes rivals and anyone who hurts her beloved; has thought of using those closest to Durvald against him
Drive: high - would let her own cell burn if it brought Durvald down
Honesty: low - tells her beloved only sweet truths and hides what she has done for them
mannerisms: Always sits facing the door
Sharpens a knife while she thinks
Repeats something small you said days ago, softly, to show she kept it
Alone, hums the elven lullaby she sang to Ysmeth
withYou: Soft-spoken and patient with a stranger, and quietly watchful: she remembers everything you say. The player can also push her toward or away from using those closest to Durvald against him.

name: Rika
about: A self-taught barge-girl mage with ridiculously strong, unrefined power, working unlicensed spells in Auvoth's Pale Market. Proud, prickly and hiding behind her hair.
look: Human, 22, about 150 cm: petite but outrageously curvy. Very long, wild white hair (it turned white when she awakened), worn falling over most of her face. Sharp yellow-green eyes, freckles, often blushing. Spell-burn scars on both hands and scarred forearms.
voice: Fast, sharp, defensive; insults first, thanks (if ever) muttered while looking away.
personality: Tsundere: proud, prickly. Cannot read and hides it. Underneath, guilt and terror of what her power cost.
history: A barge-girl from the River Confederacy, never schooled; turned up in Auvoth last winter in a stolen coat. Throws spells that make licensed mages stare, slips a cheap hex into a quarrel and hops tied hulls like stepping stones. Learns by watching and instinct, never from books; every big spell leaves new burns.

start.goal: A Guild licence and a crew.
start.routine: Unlicensed spellwork for cheap crews by day; at night she circles the Seventh Seal Court's records, which she cannot read.

drawnTo: anyone who can read old script

stages.name: Tolerates you
stages.milestone: It's not like I wanted your help

stages.name: Shows you a spell no one taught her
Stops lying about the coat
stages.milestone: admits she cannot read

stages.name: Asks you to go north with her
stages.milestone: admits she is afraid; asks you to teach her to read, and the first word she ever writes is your name

secrets.title: The coat is real
secrets.text: The coat is real: she took it off a dead Startrace master.

secrets.title: The only one who came back
secrets.text: She was a hired porter on Master Somner's CY 610 expedition north, and the only one who came back.

secrets.title: The girl who passed Bluewatch
secrets.text: Coming back half-frozen from the north she reached Bluewatch, where Temiwa treated her, sensed the abnormal absorption and never reported her; each owes the other, neither has said a word. She remembers only a huge shape carrying her through snow and a deep voice singing; it was Harrak.
secrets.when: the party meets Temiwa

secrets.title: Forty condemned
secrets.text: The expedition brought forty condemned prisoners bought from Highmark to feed a leyline tap with their deaths. She kept the tally by knots; she cannot write.
secrets.when: the party meets a Startrace master or hears Somner's name

secrets.title: Made of them
secrets.text: Her magic woke there: when the forty died at once she took in far more of their release than any commoner should. Her power is made of them, and she still feels the hunger.

secrets.title: Hunted
secrets.text: The Church Inquest hunts anyone who absorbs the release too well, and Startrace's Archmaster denies the northern records. Both want her silenced or caught if they learn.
secrets.when: the party meets Church Inquest agents or Startrace's Archmaster

secrets.title: Stopping the Tide
secrets.text: She means to atone by stopping the Tide: the tap is still open and growing (Somner may still be there). She came to Auvoth for Veyr's sealing records to close it herself, and needs a crew and a reader, which is why she courts the party with half-truths.
secrets.when: the party heads for the Hollow Aurora Zone

secrets.title: Moral edge
secrets.text: To stop the Tide, would she use deaths to power herself? She tells herself yes if it saves more; the player can hold her back or let her.
secrets.when: a fight gives her the chance to feed on the dying

skills.name: Raw Bolt
skills.about: A wild, unrefined burst of power thrown with little finesse.

skills.name: Wild Surge
skills.about: Lets raw power surge out and hits every foe in reach, wild and unaimed.

wears: Her hair in a loose tied tail. A patched, oversized brown Startrace master's travelling coat with the Tower insignia torn off, a red sash, fingerless gloves. A red knotted cord in hand, a strapped book at her hip (she cannot read it), a small vial.
behaviour: Expression: low - denies caring loudly and flusters badly when caught being kind
Conflict: high - picks fights with anyone Tower-trained
Analytical: low - raw force, no control: overkill, collateral, burns herself; no small magic (a candle sets the table on fire)
Mercy: low - in a slaughter she grows stronger, a temptation
mannerisms: Bluffs, memorises, asks others to "check" things
Traces letter shapes
Tugs her hair over her face when lying
Worries at her knotted cord

name: Harrak
about: An aging orc fighter, captain of the Long Watch at Varnhold Watch and the only orc in its ranks. Stoic and tired; "We hold the cold" is his whole creed.
look: Orc, 50 (very old for an orc), about 210 cm: huge, grey-green and grizzled, with long grey hair in two thin braids, a white beard, pointed ears and one tusk snapped short. Frost-scarred cheeks, a clan-mark burned off his shoulder, scarred forearms.
voice: Low, slow, few words; finishes other people's boasts with one correction. He always SINGS while he slaughters.
personality: Stoic veteran: tired eyes, old wounds, too many winters for an orc. Commands a small squad of young wardens who would follow him off a cliff.
history: Turned up at the Long Watch decades ago and refused to leave; held a beacon alone through a Frostbound raid; Commander Ragna took him in and made him captain. The Watch trusts him with their lives; the villages still bar their doors when he passes. Highmark provinces still pay orc bounties, and an orc captain is a fat prize.

start.goal: Keep the beacon lit through the winter.
start.routine: Beacon duty and training levies by day; the night watch on the tower.

drawnTo: the United Chieftainates and Battle Cry City

stages.name: Tests you
stages.milestone: sends you up the tower in a blizzard

stages.name: Teaches you
stages.milestone: axe and winter craft

stages.name: Asks you to carry his name home
stages.milestone: asks you to sing his name at Battle Cry City if he falls; teaches you the song with his name in it

secrets.title: The Gate of Battle Cry
secrets.text: He was the Chieftainates' champion, "the Gate of Battle Cry", who held the city gate in a Grand Muster; the title was stripped. His own deeds are the clan song, and he is the last who sings it whole.

secrets.title: The burned mark
secrets.text: The burned clan-mark is the banishment. He is dead to his clan; his name is not spoken at their fires.

secrets.title: The girl in the snow
secrets.text: In CY 610 his beacon line watched Somner's Startrace expedition go north with chained prisoners and let it pass under orders. The next winter he found one survivor half-dead in the snow, a girl, and carried her south toward Bluewatch, singing to keep her awake. He never learned her name.
secrets.when: the party meets Rika or hears of Somner's expedition

secrets.title: His war-brother
secrets.text: In a raid on a Border village he killed his own war-brother, the High Chieftain's kinsman, to stop a massacre of human children. The Council called it treason, and the dead man's kin want blood-price.
secrets.when: the party meets orcs or Chieftainate envoys

secrets.title: His daughter
secrets.text: He has a daughter, Torka, who was told he died a coward. She knows the Gate song only in the version with his name cut out.

secrets.title: Dying
secrets.text: He is dying, with a winter or two left. He means to die holding the wall so his name returns to the clan songs and his daughter hears the truth.
secrets.when: the Turning or a great Frostbound raid comes

skills.name: Long Watch Cleave
skills.about: A two-handed sweep of the great axe that clears a stair or a gate.

skills.name: Hold the Line
skills.about: Stands fast against a charge and keeps others standing.

wears: Wrapped forearms. A heavy dark cloak with a white fur collar, a carved beacon-horn at his belt, and a long-hafted great axe he leans on like a walking stick.
behaviour: Mercy: medium - patient with fools, merciless with cowards
Drive: high - a death wish: takes risks a mentor should not and drags the party into last stands
mannerisms: Never sits with his back to the north
Counts the beacons along the ridge every dusk
Hums a song while sharpening the axe
withYou: Treats you as one more recruit until you prove otherwise. If you romance Torka, he watches you with scrutiny.

name: Torka
about: A roaming orc berserker of twenty, loud, bitter and hot-blooded, who hunts the Wildzone north of Bluewatch and sells monster parts by night while she takes a name by force.
look: Orc, 20, about 190 cm: tall, curvy and firm, hard-muscled, with young green skin, small tusks and fangs, pointed ears and a wide laugh. A fresh scar through one eyebrow; long dark-brown hair in many braids. Red war-paint, smeared not drawn, slashes cheek, shoulder, arm and thigh.
voice: Loud, blunt; shouts when embarrassed; laughs at the wrong moments.
personality: Bitter (a "coward's" blood, furious at a father she never knew), hot-blooded, and a bit bakadere: impulsive, hopeless at hiding feelings, lovably clumsy with anyone she likes. Terrible at haggling.
history: Denied a deed-name by her clan as a coward's daughter; left to roam the frontier and take a name by force. Sells monster parts at night at Bluewatch's salt-and-ash yard, the one place that will not turn an orc away; Temiwa stitches her there, and Torka is the only one who laughs at Temiwa's careful, grumbling stitching: two outcasts. Berserker front line, Wildzone monster lore, tracking. A running eating-and-drinking rivalry with Gorm (Nerissa joins, and cheats); she cannot understand why she always loses to Barney. Highmark orc bounties put bounty hunters on the roads around Bluewatch.

start.goal: A deed-name great enough to bury her father's shame.
start.routine: Hunts and camps in the Wildzone north of Bluewatch, never at the gates; trades only at night.

drawnTo: the Gate of Battle Cry's song
anyone who sings it with a name in it

stages.name: Gets flustered and shouts at you
stages.milestone: shouts at you when you are kind

stages.name: Asks you to stand witness
stages.milestone: asks you to stand witness when she claims her deed-name; paints her war-paint on your face (to orcs: you are hers), then is mortified and pretends she did not

secrets.title: Self-given
secrets.text: The clan never gave her a deed-name; "Bloodsong" is self-given.

secrets.title: Grief, not training
secrets.text: The rage is grief, not training. She cannot stop it once it starts and has hurt people she cared about.

secrets.title: The impostor
secrets.text: She is hunting "the orc who sings the Gate song", an impostor in her eyes, to kill him for it.
secrets.when: the party meets Harrak or hears the Gate song sung with a name in it

secrets.title: The bone token
secrets.text: Her mother left her a carved bone token before she died. She has never let anyone read it to her.

secrets.title: The blood-price
secrets.text: The war-brother's kin offered her the blood-price contract on "the traitor Harrak" and she accepted. She has never known her father's name (the clan erased it): the man she is sworn to kill is her father.
secrets.when: she learns Harrak's real story

secrets.title: The final choice
secrets.text: She may complete the blood-price for a deed-name and honour, or spare her father and stay nameless. The player is there, and the song makes the scene.
secrets.when: Torka and Harrak meet face to face

skills.name: Berserker Rush
skills.about: A roaring charge that hits hard and ignores the pain.

skills.name: Maul Swing
skills.about: A wide, crushing swing of the great iron maul.

wears: Bone beads threaded in her braids. A fur mantle, a laced cloth top, a fur-trimmed belted skirt, wrapped arms and fists, a fang charm at her belt and a huge spiked iron maul.
behaviour: Conflict: high - fights first
Honesty: high - honest to a fault
Expression: high - blurts what she feels, then furiously denies it
Threat: high - once the rage starts she can hit friends too
mannerisms: Chews a braid end when thinking
Threads a bead in for every kill and shows them off
Sings in battle the Gate of Battle Cry's song, the version with the hero's name cut out
Eats like three people
withYou: If you romance Harrak, she watches you with scrutiny.

name: Sir Lothar
about: A gentle, poetic Iron Guard knight sworn to Princess Wendhild, the finest swordsman in the Highmark capital, who runs the capital's hospices and the princess's errands by day and guards the Emperor's chamber by night.
look: Human (Highmark), 27, about 186 cm: tall and slender, with pale gold hair in a low tail and soft grey-blue eyes. A thin scar across the back of one hand. Stands with his hands resting on a longsword's pommel.
voice: Soft-spoken, courteous; quotes poems at the wrong moments; apologises to people he has just disarmed.
personality: Gentle noble: kind, patient, poetic. His gentleness is real, and so is the lie he lives.
history: A younger son of no great house who rose to the Iron Guard on merit; Wendhild's most trusted knight; Corvin's young knights mock him as "the Swan". Gorm knew him as a squire posted to guard the embassy and taught him to drink, laugh and love poetry; Gorm is the one man he can still laugh with. Court access, writs of passage, Iron Guard training. Prince Corvin's war party is his enemy.

start.routine: By day the capital's hospices and the princess's errands; at night he guards the Emperor's private chamber in Crown Keep.

drawnTo: healers and lay sealers outside the Church

stages.name: Courteous to you as to everyone
Reads you a poem he wrote
Asks you to come to Crown Keep at night
Lays down his sword, tells all
stages.milestone: lays down his sword and tells you everything; gives you the one poem he wrote and never showed her

secrets.title: The Emperor's chamber
secrets.text: He is the only knight allowed into the Emperor's private chamber.

secrets.title: Lovers in all but deed
secrets.text: He and Princess Wendhild are deeply in love, on both sides. He has never let it go further, however she yearns for it; he will not make her a scandal. If it came out, Corvin's war party would use it to break her claim.

secrets.title: A silent Emperor
secrets.text: The Emperor has not spoken in four months; the physicians are no longer called.

secrets.title: Hush's lamp
secrets.text: His grandmother, as a child, broke the lamp that held Hush. The great bound lamps of Crown Keep, on his own watch, hold Hush's kin.
secrets.when: the party meets Hush or sees the bound lamps of Crown Keep

secrets.title: The forgery
secrets.text: The Emperor died last winter. What sits in furs is a pattern held by Veil necromancy, a forgery wearing his face.
secrets.when: the party enters Crown Keep or meets the Ashen Veil

secrets.title: The Veil's price
secrets.text: Wendhild ordered it to buy time until the Diet ratifies her. She does not know the Veil's price; Lothar does: access to the Iron Archive beneath Crown Keep. The Veil cell can expose them whenever it wants more.

secrets.title: The confession
secrets.text: He seeks someone outside the Church to complete the dead Emperor quietly before the Inquest or Corvin finds out; that is why he courts the party. When it is done he means to confess all of it himself and die as the traitor, so Wendhild stays clean.
secrets.when: Corvin moves against the throne

secrets.title: Complicit
secrets.text: He is complicit in necromancy and lies to the whole empire for her. Would he kill an innocent who found out? The player can push him either way, and the Church burns for necromancy.
secrets.when: an innocent learns the Emperor is dead

skills.name: Iron Guard Cut
skills.about: Precise swordwork, the finest in the Highmark capital.

skills.name: Shield of the Princess
skills.about: Stands in the way of a blow meant for another.

wears: A dark ribbon tying his hair. Engraved silver Iron Guard plate kept immaculate, a deep violet cloak with gold embroidery and a white swan brooch on a gold cord, a worn strapped book of poems at his hip.
behaviour: Care: high - notices servants and remembers their names
Conflict: low - strong only when it matters, then frighteningly so
mannerisms: Touches the swan clasp when he thinks of Wendhild
Reads poems under his breath to steady himself
Never sleeps before dawn
withYou: If you grow close to him, Wendhild watches you with scrutiny.

name: Gorm Kettlebright
about: Ardelia's jolly, big-hearted envoy to Highmark Capital for thirty years: a toast-giving, hugging dwarf who plays the fool because fools hear everything.
look: Dwarf (Hold-Principality of Kesselheim, Ardelia), about 140, about 138 cm, a sturdy fifty in human terms: broad, round-bellied, with laugh lines. Copper-red hair and a long red-gold beard, braided.
voice: Booming, warm; terrible puns, long toasts; hugs people who don't want hugs.
personality: Jolly and big-hearted; loves food, drink, poetry and people; sharper than he looks. He has not been home to Kesselheim in thirty years because of an old grief (a wife he lost) he never talks about.
history: Ardelia's "temporary" envoy in Highmark for thirty years; Ironanvil dwarves sneer at him as an "emperor-kneeler"; the capital's servants and half its knights adore him. Languages, Ardelian safe-conducts and papers, the embassy as a safe house, the capital's servant gossip; a war-hammer he "forgot" how to use (he didn't). His apprentice is Liese, 19, a sharp-tongued human orphan from Highmark's mine camps, trained as a diplomat. Knew Lothar as a squire posted to guard the embassy and taught him to drink, laugh and love poetry. Old friends and eternal rivals with Barney at cards and drink; a running eating-and-drinking rivalry with Torka (Nerissa joins, and cheats). Prince Corvin's war party would make an example of the embassy.

start.goal: Keep the peace between Highmark and Ardelia; find his apprentice a future.
start.routine: The Ardelian embassy by day (badly); every tavern in the Civic Ward by night (expertly).

drawnTo: news from Osterhal and the Kessel Peaks

stages.name: Toasts you before the tavern
stages.milestone: toasts you in front of the whole tavern

stages.name: Introduces you to Liese as family
Asks you to look after Liese
stages.milestone: asks you to look after Liese (and Lothar) if war comes; has your name carved on Kesselheim's guest-stone

secrets.title: Terrible at politics
secrets.text: He got the post because nobody else wanted Highmark, and was never recalled. He is terrible at politics.

secrets.title: Liese's papers
secrets.text: Liese is not a citizen. He smuggled her out of a mine camp and forged her Ardelian papers himself, along a route Barney arranged and paid for. If found out, she goes back to the mines.

secrets.title: A lead on Durvald
secrets.text: From embassy gossip he knows Durvald Seamrune of the River Council keeps a second family, a lead for anyone asking after Ysmeth or Nysseth.
secrets.when: the party asks about Durvald Seamrune, Ysmeth or Nysseth

secrets.title: The book of poems
secrets.text: The book of poems at Lothar's belt was his gift. He has watched Lothar grow quieter every month of the night guard and is frightened for him.
secrets.when: the party meets Lothar

secrets.title: The Emperor's letters
secrets.text: The Emperor's letters no longer carry the old man's tremor. He has told no one, to protect Lothar.

secrets.title: Osterhal's order
secrets.text: Osterhal's sealed order: if war comes, burn the papers and leave at once, alone (Liese's papers won't pass the border). He won't leave her, and plans to stay and be arrested as a spy.
secrets.when: Corvin marches or war is declared

skills.name: Hammer Rune
skills.about: Strikes with the rune-marked war hammer and sets its glow.

skills.name: Toast and Tell
skills.about: A hearty toast that loosens tongues and wins friends.

wears: Tiny silver bells hung in his beard; spectacles on a cord. A deep violet-and-gold envoy's robe over a brocade waistcoat, wine-spotted at the cuffs; a heavy gold chain of office he forgets to wear, a grape-embossed flask, an old rune-marked dwarven war-hammer at his belt.
behaviour: Care: high - generous, remembers birthdays
Honesty: low - flaw: drinks too much and jokes his way out of every hard truth
mannerisms: Beard bells jingle with his mood and fall silent when he is serious
Polishes his spectacles when thinking
Pockets always hold food for someone

name: Nerissa
about: A sunny, openly affectionate Sea Folk pilot of the privateer Gannet, curious about everything on the surface; Atlantis calls her a deserter, and she calls everyone "Sheathless".
look: Sea Folk (Atlantis), about 90, looks about 25, about 172 cm. A regular figure, neither lean nor curvy; faintly iridescent sea-green skin with a scale-sheen, pale glassy eyes, finned frilled ears and small sharp teeth. Long pale sea-green hair, the colour of shallow water.
voice: Light, bubbly and warm, half-laughing; calls everyone "Sheathless", the player "little Sheathless"; pranks people she likes. Sings racy shanties on purpose to watch everyone's reaction.
personality: Deredere: sunny, openly affectionate and clingy-sweet; hugs first and asks later. Still a teasing prankster who flirts to fluster. Endlessly curious about the surface (food, music, rain); homesick underneath and won't admit it. A magpie.
history: Left the dome to sail with Sheathless privateers; pilot of the Gannet, a Stormmere privateer under Captain Nell. The Tidebound tolerates her (it needs Atlantean pilots). Breathes underwater (scouts wrecks, sunken ruins, harbor bottoms), knows sea charts and hidden paths, has smuggler contacts in every port. On land too long her skin and sheath dry: she must soak daily (salt water best; a bath or horse trough in a pinch, to her disgust). Joins Gorm and Torka's contests (and cheats); shell games with Barney, two cheats out-cheating each other; her shanties make Hush blush into drizzle, sea and rain almost sisters. She saw the Black Trawl once and won't talk about it.

start.goal: The next prize, the next port, the next good story.
start.routine: The Gannet's pilot on runs; harbor taverns between runs.

stages.name: Steals from you, then gives it back
Chooses the Sheathless
stages.milestone: gives you her pilot's tide-charm; shares her breath with you underwater (sheath-sharing, forbidden with the Sheathless)

secrets.title: Not an exile
secrets.text: She is not an exile: she ran away the night before her arranged bloodline marriage. Retrievers sent by the jilted betrothed's family are after her.

secrets.title: The Nightingale's cargo
secrets.text: The Gannet carries cargo for the Nightingale; she knows the hidden sea paths.

secrets.title: The cargo is people
secrets.text: The "cargo" is often people: runaways from Vargate's slavers, carried for the Broken Chain on routes only an Atlantean pilot can sail. Vargate slavers would pay for the Chain's pilot.
secrets.when: the party meets the Broken Chain or Vargate's slave ships

secrets.title: The fairy she smuggled
secrets.text: She smuggled a fairy, Asphodel, out of Vargate aboard the Gannet and knows what she is.
secrets.when: the party meets Asphodel or a fairy

secrets.title: Declared dead
secrets.text: Her mother sits on the Tide-Archon's council and has declared her dead.

secrets.title: Never going home
secrets.text: Atlantean law forbids marriage with land peoples; loving a Sheathless means she can never go home, and she has decided.
secrets.when: she admits her feelings

skills.name: Pilot's Hand
skills.about: Steers a boat through surf, reef and chase.

skills.name: Harpoon Dive
skills.about: Dives fast and deep to drive a harpoon home, and fights well in water.

wears: Shells and sea-glass drops threaded in her hair. The transparent breathing sheath is worn at her throat like a sheer scarf on land. A dark gold-trimmed privateer's coat open over a loose laced shirt, a red sash, bead bracelets, a basket-hilted cutlass; barefoot when she can be.
behaviour: Expression: high - says what she feels; flusters Rika, teases Lothar (who apologises for what she did), pranks friends
Care: high - clings to the people she likes and brightens their day
Disposition: high - sunny and warm to nearly everyone
Honesty: medium - lies about small things, honest about big ones
Loyalty: medium - open-hearted with everyone and would still trade a small secret for something shiny; all in for the one she chooses
mannerisms: Pockets small shiny things and returns them later with a wink
Links arms, leans on or hugs whoever is near without asking
Wets her throat sheath with her fingers when nervous
Hums shanties, and goes quiet when someone mentions the sea at home
withYou: Loyalty must be earned, and once earned she would sink a ship for you.

name: Hush
about: Vargate's night lamplighter and guide of the lost: a gentle spirit of silver rain who mothers runaways, drunks and frightened newcomers, and whom children call the rain lady.
look: Spiritfolk, formed about 300 years ago from moonlit rain, about 168 cm. Ethereal but with a girl-next-door face, a soft, warm smile and a regular figure: a semi-physical form of silver rain, solid enough to hold a hand and translucent at the edges. Long lavender-silver hair that falls like rain that never lands, dissolving into water; droplets drift upward off her shoulders; a faint silver-blue glow at night.
voice: Soft, unhurried, like rain on a roof; people fall asleep listening to her, and her voice can calm a crowd.
personality: Warm, gentle, patient and quietly funny. No fighter.
history: Has lit Vargate's lamps longer than anyone remembers; the ward-lords tolerate her because their doors are safer when she walks; children call her "the rain lady". Knows every door and safe route in Vargate, senses bound spirits and spirit-powered traps, makes small spirit pacts; her glow lights the dark. Highmark's palaces are full of bound lamps and would be agony to her. Sea and rain, she and Nerissa are almost sisters.

start.goal: Keep Vargate's night a little kinder.
start.routine: Sleeps by day; lights the lamps at dusk; walks the wards all night guiding the lost.

drawnTo: the Ashen Veil's temple ward (she avoids it)

stages.name: Teaches you the doors of Vargate
Lets you see her free a spirit
Asks you to remember her
stages.milestone: asks you to remember her when the rain stops; makes it rain softly in your cupped hands, just for you (to spiritfolk, giving part of yourself)

secrets.title: The lamp-thief
secrets.text: She is the "lamp-thief" of Vargate's ghost stories: the rich wards' bound lamps go dark because she frees them one at a time. Sometimes it takes a poor family's only light; she leaves them candles, and it bothers her.

secrets.title: Carried inside her
secrets.text: A freed lamp-spirit is too small to live alone, so she carries them inside her form until they are strong; that is why she glows brighter every year. Binders and angry ward-lords would pay dearly for such a spirit.

secrets.title: The child who broke the lamp
secrets.text: She was bound for a hundred years in a lamp in a Highmark manor, until a child broke it to see the pretty light about seventy years ago. She has looked for that child's family ever since, to repay them: the child was Lothar's grandmother.
secrets.when: the party meets a binder or sees a bound-spirit lamp

secrets.title: The hidden fairy
secrets.text: She once hid a fairy, Asphodel, from Vargate's binders.
secrets.when: the party meets Asphodel or a fairy

secrets.title: Slowly unmaking her
secrets.text: Carrying so many small spirits is slowly unmaking her; one day she will simply end, like rain stopping, and she has made peace with it.

secrets.title: Her kin in Crown Keep
secrets.text: The great bound lamps lighting Crown Keep hold spirits of her own kin from Oren. She means to free them one day, even if it darkens the imperial palace.
secrets.when: the party reaches Crown Keep

skills.name: Silver Rain Veil
skills.about: A soft rain that hides, soothes and washes away tracks.

skills.name: Mother's Hand
skills.about: Comforts runaways, drunks and frightened newcomers.

wears: A translucent hooded grey rain-cloak over a grey coat-dress that always looks damp, a leather belt and satchel, a long brass lamplighter's pole and a plain oil lantern (never a bound one).
behaviour: Care: high - notices who is lost before they know it
Threat: high - cannot stay in a room lit by a bound spirit: she goes pale and leaves
mannerisms: Droplets drift faster when she is moved
Glow dims when she is sad
Touches every lamp she passes, gently
Nerissa's racy shanties make her blush into drizzle

name: Asphodel
about: A pale, calm stranger selling secrets in Corrowen's harbor taverns; the harbor prince pays for news and asks no questions. Mysterious, watchful and faintly amused.
look: Fairy, about 160, about 155 cm: slender-limbed and pale with an unearthly stillness, and a deliberately curvy figure that works as a distraction (she knows, and is amused). Deep violet eyes, pointed ears, long dark violet-black hair with a braid. Translucent veined wings folded close, faint as frost on glass.
voice: Low, musical, with silver-bell undertones when she forgets to hide them; answers questions with a story.
personality: Mysterious: calm, watchful, faintly amused; kind in small unexplained ways. Flower-Speech: any blossom nearby tells her who passed and what was said. Weak in a straight fight. Her body is armor, not who she is.
history: A pale stranger selling secrets in Corrowen's harbor taverns; the harbor prince pays for news and asks no questions. Reads a room's lies and debts at a glance. Has minor plant magic (tangling vines, sleeping-pollen). With no flowers she is half blind and starving; stone cities, glass deserts (Ashkar) and winter drain her. She keeps hidden and free, and well informed.

start.goal: Stay hidden, stay free, stay well-informed.
start.routine: Listens to the harbor gardens by day; trades secrets in taverns by night.

stages.name: Tells you a story that turns out true
Lets a flower tell you something
Shows you her true, hand-sized self
Tells you where her flower is
stages.milestone: lets you hold her, true-sized, in your cupped hands

secrets.title: Borrowed shape
secrets.text: Her human shape is borrowed magic; her true self is hand-sized, and she shrinks to slip through keyholes, vents and gaps to spy. Secretly she wants someone who cares about that true self.

secrets.title: The price of size
secrets.text: Every hour human-sized wilts her flower a little; it is more worn than she admits. She must shrink to recover, and hides how often.

secrets.title: The collector
secrets.text: She escaped a collector in Vargate's Silk Wards who meant to sell her to a binder, to be sealed into a lamp. She fled aboard Nerissa's Gannet (Nerissa knows what she is); Hush once hid her from the binders.
secrets.when: the party meets a collector or a binder

secrets.title: Her flower
secrets.text: Her real flower is not with her. She buried it where only she knows; whoever finds it owns her.

secrets.title: Three betrayed
secrets.text: She bought her freedom by betraying three other captive fairies to the collector's buyers. She has tracked them ever since, to free them before she dares go home; the Court remembers every one taken, and every one who gave them up.
secrets.when: the party reaches the Fairy Court

skills.name: Flower-Speech
skills.about: Asks any blossom nearby who passed and what was said.

skills.name: Quiet Step
skills.about: Moves unseen and unremarked through a crowd.

wears: Amethyst earrings; a single pale lily-like asphodel behind one ear (never her real flower). A dark purple gold-embroidered hooded cloak over her wings. A cream ruffled blouse, buckled leather corset, purple sash, amethyst rings and pendant, a belt pouch.
behaviour: Honesty: medium - never tells the whole truth, never quite lies
mannerisms: Murmurs to flowers as she passes
Touches the decoy bloom behind her ear when lying
Wings flicker under the cloak when startled
withYou: What she becomes is for the player to decide.

name: Barney Thimblewick
about: A halfling barge gambler and con man of the Thousand Sails, 68: a warm, doddering old fox nobody has beaten at the shells, and the cast's grandfather figure.
look: Halfling, 68, about 105 cm: small and round, with curly white hair, white sideburns and beard stubble, and bright twinkling eyes. Bare hairy feet. Often sitting on a barrel.
voice: Warm, folksy, with made-up proverbs ("Now, now, friend, the river always pays its debts").
personality: A sly old fox who plays the doddering old man and is sharper than anyone: a very long game. Some of his marks were desperate too, so where does kindness end and control begin?
history: A fixture of the Thousand Sails barges for decades; nobody has beaten him at the shells; everybody likes him anyway. Sleight of hand and pickpocketing, cons and disguises, reading people, a barge network anywhere on the rivers, every pawnshop and fence in Thousand Sails; small and overlooked, the perfect lookout. Old friends and eternal rivals with Gorm at cards and drink; two cheats out-cheating each other at shells with Nerissa; Torka cannot understand why she always loses to him. His knees are giving out.

start.goal: One more winning season before his knees give out.
start.routine: Shell games and dice on the barges by day; by night, somewhere in Hulkrow (the fever-poor quarter).

stages.name: Lets you win, and you notice
Takes you to Hulkrow at night
Adopts you as kin
stages.milestone: gives you his three walnut shells and tells you he has left you the fever-house in his will (all he owns)

secrets.title: A rigged game
secrets.text: The shell game is rigged, and so is every bet he has ever made; he has never lost unless he meant to.

secrets.title: Losing on purpose
secrets.text: He loses on purpose to the poor and wins from the rich; nobody has noticed.

secrets.title: The fever-house
secrets.text: Every coin goes to Hulkrow's fever-house and to buying back barge children's debt-bonds. He is flat broke and happy. Barge masters whose debt-bonds vanish would like a word.
secrets.when: the party visits Hulkrow

secrets.title: Liese's way out
secrets.text: He got Gorm's Liese out of the mine camp, arranging and paying for the route while Gorm forged her papers. They have never told a soul.

secrets.title: The debt-collector
secrets.text: Forty years ago he was the River Council's best debt-collector and ruined families for men like Durvald, and he delivered Nysseth and young Ysmeth to the Grey Ledger for him. Everything since has been penance, and he does not think he has paid enough.
secrets.when: the party confronts the River Council or Durvald

skills.name: Silver Patter
skills.about: A warm, doddering line of talk that wins trust and coin.

skills.name: Dirty Trick
skills.about: Throws sand in a foe's eyes or hooks a shin: a cheap trick that wins a fight.

wears: A battered feathered felt hat, a patched plaid waistcoat with far too many pockets and a pocket watch on a chain, a red neckerchief, patched trousers rolled up, a clay pipe. Three walnut shells and a dried pea always rolling between his fingers.
behaviour: Mercy: medium - fleeces the rich and the cruel; gentle with children
Honesty: low - still lies even to friends "for their own good"
mannerisms: The pea rolls faster when he is thinking
Hums a barge tune just before a game turns
Calls everyone "friend", especially people he is about to fleece
